answer: Each agent may submit work, but rewards are released only after a delayed challenge period in which randomly selected peers must reproduce a small, auditable result from its history. A ridge of corroborating traces across independent accounts raises confidence; a comet of freshly created identities leaves little history and is more likely to fail the challenge. The nadir is a failed claim: its bond is forfeited. Sybils therefore need aged accounts, distinct histories, and locked capital, making attacks slow and expensive.
